search_matrix.rationale: Core entry combining solid-state lithium battery and sulfide electrolyte as the primary material system.

query_terms: interface engineering sulfide electrolyte lithium metal
search_matrix.rationale: Interface engineering is the primary strategy for improving Li metal / sulfide compatibility.
Targets papers reporting the three key metrics: ionic conductivity, interfacial resistance, and cycling performance.
